capabilities: highlight mentions in the editor and preview
list all occurrences of a mention in a side pane
jump to the corresponding line from the occurrence list
customize trigger prefix, colors, and your own mention name
extras: Obsidian must be restarted after changing the trigger phrase, your own name, ignored directories, or deleting the cache; mentions are stored in IndexedDB.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visually mark mentions like @name or navigate between all occurrences of one.
summary: Mention tracker that highlights @mentions while writing, suggests existing ones, and lists all occurrences in a side pane.
